action_input.sql: SELECT COUNT(m.member_id) FROM (SELECT unnest(records) AS m FROM read_json_auto('json/member.json')) AS m JOIN (SELECT unnest(records) AS j FROM read_json_auto('json/major.json')) AS j ON m.link_to_major = j.major_id WHERE j.major_name = 'Physics Teaching'
